annotations.title: List the events you can subscribe to

description:
List the events you can subscribe to

Returns the catalogue of outbound events with a one-line explanation of when each is emitted. These names, plus the wildcard returned in `wildcard`, are the only values accepted in the `events` list when creating or updating an endpoint. `webhook.test` appears in the catalogue but is never produced by platform activity: it is only sent when you ask for a test delivery.
name: list_webhook_events
